display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
T1 POST /v1/metrics breaches the threshold and no breach_series is open (REQ-03)
T2 a REVIEWER's GET /v1/events/{event_id} of a FLAGGED breach event (spec D3)
T3 POST .../disposition, tier DEATH, CRITICAL_INFRASTRUCTURE_OR_WIDESPREAD or OTHER_SERIOUS,
all four harm fields CONFIRMED or NOT_APPLICABLE; deadline_utc from the assignment
T4 POST .../disposition, NOT_SERIOUS with a non-blank rationale, four fields decided; no deadline
T5 stricter or same tier keeps the first anchor (shorter deadline); a looser tier needs a rationale
T6 NOT_SERIOUS with a rationale: deadline cleared, PENDING reminders cancelled (D2)
T7 serious tier: deadline from the first anchor; looser than the last serious tier needs a rationale
T8 NOT_SERIOUS with a rationale again
Phase 2 names: CLASSIFIED(tier) = DISPOSITIONED, CLOSED_NOT_SERIOUS = CLOSED.
Not implemented (Phase 5): REPORT_READY, SUBMITTED. GET .../report gives 409 NO_DISPOSITION, then 501.
Responses, not states (nothing written): DENIED = 401 or 403 FORBIDDEN_ROLE;
REJECTED = 400 RATIONALE_REQUIRED or MALFORMED_BODY, 409 HARM_FIELDS_UNCONFIRMED,
409 DEADLINE_EXTENSION_REQUIRES_RATIONALE, 409 EVENT_NOT_REVIEWABLE (gap event).
A breach on the metric of a CLOSED event opens a new event (decision 227).
Every transition appends a ledger_entry (REQ-06, REQ-14).

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
G1 no sample for gap_timeout_intervals x sampling_interval (REQ-02)
G2 the next sample from that system closes the gap
A gap event is never reviewed or dispositioned.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
E1 first serious tier: one row per ESCALATION_PERCENTAGES value (50, 80, 100)
E2 replan: a revision moves due_at
E3 due: due_at reached in a worker pass or clock advance;
REMINDER_TRIGGERED appended, reminder notification enqueued (REQ-11)
E4 revision to NOT_SERIOUS
E5 revision back to a serious tier. SENT rows never change.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
N1 flag_notification or reminder enqueued for each matching webhook
N2 retry: failed attempt, next try after 10, 30, 60, 120, 300 s
N3 webhook answers 2xx
N4 sixth failed attempt

svg.text: Model 1 - Event state machine as built (Phase 4, main 9b2e587)
